sources.entry: Holeberry - A native and modern macOS menu bar app to monitor and control your Pi-hole instances.

summary.one_liner: Holeberry is a native macOS menu bar app for monitoring and controlling Pi-hole instances without opening the Pi-hole web interface.
summary.what_it_does: Shows Pi-hole blocking status and query stats in the menu bar, and lets you disable blocking globally for a set time or indefinitely, with a countdown timer that re-enables blocking automatically. It can unblock the domain of the current browser tab (Safari/Orion, Chrome/Chromium, Firefox/Zen and similar) and add domains to an allowlist. It can trigger gravity updates on all servers at once, either manually, from a global keyboard shortcut, or on a schedule (6/12 hours, daily, weekly, or never). It lists recently blocked domains from your Mac or all clients, with unblock and allowlist actions. It supports up to two Pi-hole instances, applying actions to all of them at the same time, and stores credentials in the macOS Keychain.
use_cases: control Pi-hole from the macOS menu bar
temporarily disable ad blocking for a set time
unblock a site that fails to load in my browser
trigger Pi-hole gravity updates without the web admin
monitor query and blocked-domain stats for two Pi-hole servers
how_to_run: Download the latest Holeberry-.dmg from the Releases page
Open the DMG and drag Holeberry into the Applications folder
To build from source: git clone the repository and cd into Holeberry
Select the Holeberry scheme and press Run (⌘R)
Core logic tests: cd Packages/HoleberryCore && swift test
notable: Applies blocking, unblocking and allowlist changes to all configured Pi-hole instances simultaneously
One-click unblock of the domain in the current browser tab, across WebKit, Chromium and Gecko browsers
Global keyboard shortcut for gravity updates and scheduled gravity updates
Password-less Pi-hole instances supported; credentials kept in the macOS Keychain
Signed with Developer ID and notarized by Apple
caveats: Supports up to two Pi-hole instances; Pi-hole v5 support is noted as not fully tested
Browser-tab unblocking needs Automation permission and, on macOS 27+, an extra Files & Folders toggle for Firefox/Zen/Waterfox
